one_idea.line: Yes. The auditor opening old pages and finding money or a skeleton carries both cuts. Real pages are held still with no marks. The short hook is the $195,000 from frame 0, with the line on 'fraction' (w18). The code slams (BILLED, EXPENSIVE, BROTHER-IN-LAW) and hindsight slams are his words on the words he says. act and l_act, now anchor, still end on his own invoices and his skeletons, so the role change adds no second idea.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. The counters show only bill-billed and bill-after (195,000 and 33,000) with their producer line 'Tom's Hardware, 29 Oct 2025 (the family's account)', and the ghost waits for a finished count. No slam word or tape has a digit. The real-page figures in l_tenant and l_krafton are on their own pages with no marks. The role change touches no figure.
